## What this is

P1 analog of `panel_I_scenario_heatmap.pdf` — a diverging heatmap of
signal-flow `net_input` per P1 subtype under the three encounter scenarios.
Rows = scenarios, columns = P1 subtypes (clustered for readability), color =
net input (blue = inhibited, red = excited).

```{r build-matrix}
scenarios <- c(
  "Female (ppk25)" = "ppk25",
  "cVA + male (cVA+ppk23)"       = "DA1+ppk23",
  "cVA + female (cVA+ppk25)"     = "DA1+ppk25"
)
scenario_colors <- c(
  "Female (ppk25)" = "#D73027",
  "cVA + male (cVA+ppk23)"       = "#8E24AA",
  "cVA + female (cVA+ppk25)"     = "#F57C00"
)

p1_subtypes <- unique(p1_all_combos$target_type)

scenario_data_sf <- list()
for (nm in names(scenarios)) {
  d <- p1_all_combos %>%
    filter(combination == scenarios[[nm]]) %>%
    select(target_type, net_input)
  scenario_data_sf[[nm]] <- setNames(d$net_input, d$target_type)
}

sf_scenario_p1_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(scenario_data_sf, function(v) v[p1_subtypes]))
rownames(sf_scenario_p1_mat) <- names(scenarios)
sf_scenario_p1_mat[is.na(sf_scenario_p1_mat)] <- 0

cat("Signal flow P1 scenario matrix (3 x", ncol(sf_scenario_p1_mat), "):\n")
print(round(sf_scenario_p1_mat[, 1:min(10, ncol(sf_scenario_p1_mat))], 3))
```

## Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
max_abs <- max(abs(sf_scenario_p1_mat))
if (max_abs == 0) max_abs <- 1
breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 101)
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)

row_annot <- data.frame(encounter = names(scenarios), row.names = names(scenarios))
col_annot <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(sf_scenario_p1_mat))
ann_colors <- list(encounter = scenario_colors)

n_cols <- ncol(sf_scenario_p1_mat)
cw <- min(25, max(11, 500 / n_cols))
fig_w <- max(12, n_cols * cw / 72 + 4)

save_heatmap_fixed_annot(
  mat        = sf_scenario_p1_mat,
  row_annot  = row_annot,
  col_annot  = col_annot,
  ann_colors = ann_colors,
  filename   = file.path(panel_plot_dir("panel_I_p1_scenario_heatmap", "png"),
                          "panel_I_p1_scenario_heatmap.png"),
  width = fig_w, height = 5,
  breaks = breaks, color = colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 7,
  border_color = NA, cellwidth = cw, cellheight = 26
)
save_heatmap_fixed_annot(
  mat        = sf_scenario_p1_mat,
  row_annot  = row_annot,
  col_annot  = col_annot,
  ann_colors = ann_colors,
  filename   = file.path(panel_plot_dir("panel_I_p1_scenario_heatmap", "pdf"),
                          "panel_I_p1_scenario_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = fig_w, height = 5,
  breaks = breaks, color = colors,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  fontsize_row = 11, fontsize_col = 7,
  border_color = NA, cellwidth = cw, cellheight = 26
)
cat("Saved P1 scenario heatmap (", nrow(sf_scenario_p1_mat), "x", ncol(sf_scenario_p1_mat), ")\n")
```
